info.description: The Cancel Food Delivery API allows clients to streamline the cancellation of food delivery orders. This endpoint enables users to efficiently manage their orders by providing the functionality to cancel specific deliveries. Typical consumers of this API include food delivery service apps and customer support systems that require real-time order management capabilities. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their customer service and operational efficiency in handling order cancellations.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously scheduled delivery. Ensure you have the necessary permissions and that the delivery is eligible for cancellation before performing this action.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a delivery. It should contain the necessary details to identify the delivery that needs to be canceled.
